units.text: Dagger: a better way to ship
units.raw_slice: Dagger: a better way to ship

units.text: Dagger is a platform for automating software delivery.
units.raw_slice: Dagger is a platform for automating software delivery.

units.text: It can build, test and ship any codebase, reliably and at scale.
units.raw_slice: It can build, test and ship any codebase, reliably and at scale.

units.text: Dagger runs locally, in your CI server, or directly in the cloud.
units.raw_slice: Dagger runs locally, in your CI server, or directly in the cloud.

units.text: Why Dagger?
units.raw_slice: Why Dagger?

units.text: Dagger makes your software delivery programmable, local-first, repeatable and observable.
units.raw_slice: Dagger makes your software delivery *programmable*, *local-first*, *repeatable* and *observable*.

units.text: Programmable.
units.raw_slice: Programmable**.

units.text: Shell scripts and proprietary YAML are no longer acceptable for automating software delivery.
units.raw_slice: Shell scripts and proprietary YAML are no longer acceptable for automating software delivery.

units.text: Dagger provides: a complete execution engine and system API; SDKs for 8 languages; an interactive REPL; a rich ecosystem of reusable modules; and more.
units.raw_slice: Dagger provides: a complete execution engine and system API; SDKs for 8 languages; an interactive REPL; a rich ecosystem of reusable modules; and more.

units.text: Local-first.
units.raw_slice: Local-first**.

units.text: Once you automate a task with Dagger, it will reliably run on any supported system: your laptop, AI sandbox, CI server, or dedicated cloud infrastructure.
units.raw_slice: Once you automate a task with Dagger, it will reliably run on any supported system: your laptop, AI sandbox, CI server, or dedicated cloud infrastructure.

units.text: The only dependency is a container runtime like Docker.
units.raw_slice: The only dependency is a container runtime like Docker.

units.text: Repeatable.
units.raw_slice: Repeatable**.

units.text: Tools run in containers, orchestrated by sandboxed functions.
units.raw_slice: Tools run in containers, orchestrated by sandboxed functions.

units.text: Host dependencies are explicit and strictly typed.
units.raw_slice: Host dependencies are explicit and strictly typed.

units.text: Intermediate artifacts are built just-in-time.
units.raw_slice: Intermediate artifacts are built just-in-time.

units.text: Every operation is incremental by default, with advanced cache control.
units.raw_slice: Every operation is incremental by default, with advanced cache control.

units.text: Whether it's a test report, a build or a deployment, Dagger gives you an output you can trust.
units.raw_slice: Whether it's a test report, a build or a deployment, Dagger gives you an output you can trust.

units.text: Observable.
units.raw_slice: Observable**.

units.text: Every operation emits a full OpenTelemetry trace, enriched by granular logs and metrics.
units.raw_slice: Every operation emits a full OpenTelemetry trace, enriched by granular logs and metrics.

units.text: Visualize the trace in directly in the terminal, or in a web view.
units.raw_slice: Visualize the trace in directly in the terminal, or in a web view.

units.text: Debug complex workflows immediately instead of guessing what went wrong from a wall of text logs.
units.raw_slice: Debug complex workflows immediately instead of guessing what went wrong from a wall of text logs.

units.text: Features
units.raw_slice: Features

units.text: System API.
units.raw_slice: System API**.

units.text: A cross-language API for orchestrating containers, filesystems, secrets, git repositories, network tunnels, and more.
units.raw_slice: A cross-language API for orchestrating containers, filesystems, secrets, git repositories, network tunnels, and more.

units.text: Every operation is typed and composable.
units.raw_slice: Every operation is typed and composable.

units.text: SDKs in 8 languages.
units.raw_slice: SDKs in 8 languages**.

units.text: Native SDKs for Go, Python, TypeScript, PHP, Java, .NET, Elixir and Rust.
units.raw_slice: Native SDKs for Go, Python, TypeScript, PHP, Java, .NET, Elixir and Rust.

units.text: Each SDK is generated from the API schema, so you get idiomatic code with full type safety and editor support.
units.raw_slice: Each SDK is generated from the API schema, so you get idiomatic code with full type safety and editor support.

units.text: Typed artifacts.
units.raw_slice: Typed artifacts**.

units.text: Define custom object types with encapsulated state and functions.
units.raw_slice: Define custom object types with encapsulated state and functions.

units.text: Types are content-addressed and can be passed across SDK language boundaries and module boundaries without serialization.
units.raw_slice: Types are content-addressed and can be passed across SDK language boundaries and module boundaries without serialization.

units.text: Incremental execution.
units.raw_slice: Incremental execution**.

units.text: Every operation is keyed by its inputs.
units.raw_slice: Every operation is keyed by its inputs.

units.text: Change one file and only the affected operations re-run.
units.raw_slice: Change one file and only the affected operations re-run.

units.text: Caching is content-addressed and works automatically across local runs and CI.
units.raw_slice: Caching is content-addressed and works automatically across local runs and CI.

units.text: Runs anywhere.
units.raw_slice: Runs anywhere**.

units.text: The only requirement is a Linux container runtime.
units.raw_slice: The only requirement is a Linux container runtime.

units.text: Runs natively on Linux, or via Docker Desktop and similar products on macOS and Windows.
units.raw_slice: Runs natively on Linux, or via Docker Desktop and similar products on macOS and Windows.

units.text: Local and CI behavior are identical.
units.raw_slice: Local and CI behavior are identical.

units.text: Built-in tracing.
units.raw_slice: Built-in tracing**.

units.text: Every operation emits OpenTelemetry spans.
units.raw_slice: Every operation emits OpenTelemetry spans.

units.text: The CLI includes a live TUI; traces can also be exported to Jaeger, Honeycomb, or any OTel-compatible backend.
units.raw_slice: The CLI includes a live TUI; traces can also be exported to Jaeger, Honeycomb, or any OTel-compatible backend.

units.text: Prefect
units.raw_slice: Prefect

units.text: Prefect is a workflow orchestration framework for building data pipelines in Python.
units.raw_slice: Prefect is a workflow orchestration framework for building data pipelines in Python.

units.text: It's the simplest way to elevate a script into a production workflow.
units.raw_slice: It's the simplest way to elevate a script into a production workflow.

units.text: With Prefect, you can build resilient, dynamic data pipelines that react to the world around them and recover from unexpected changes.
units.raw_slice: With Prefect, you can build resilient, dynamic data pipelines that react to the world around them and recover from unexpected changes.

units.text: With just a few lines of code, data teams can confidently automate any data process with features such as scheduling, caching, retries, and event-based automations.
units.raw_slice: With just a few lines of code, data teams can confidently automate any data process with features such as scheduling, caching, retries, and event-based automations.

units.text: Workflow activity is tracked and can be monitored with a self-hosted Prefect server instance or managed Prefect Cloud dashboard.

units.text: PR Permission Requirements
units.raw_slice: PR Permission Requirements

units.text: When submitting a pull request, please ensure that Airbyte maintainers have write access to your branch.
units.raw_slice: When submitting a pull request, please ensure that Airbyte maintainers have write access to your branch.

units.text: This allows us to apply formatting fixes and dependency updates directly, significantly speeding up the review and approval process.
units.raw_slice: This allows us to apply formatting fixes and dependency updates directly, significantly speeding up the review and approval process.

units.text: To enable write access on your PR from Airbyte maintainers, please check the "Allow edits from maintainers" box when submitting from your PR.
units.raw_slice: To enable write access on your PR from Airbyte maintainers, please check the "Allow edits from maintainers" box when submitting from your PR.

units.text: You must also create your PR from a fork in your personal GitHub account rather than an organization account, or else you will not see this option.
units.raw_slice: You must also create your PR from a fork in your **personal GitHub account** rather than an organization account, or else you will not see this option.

units.text: The requirement to create from your personal fork is based on GitHub's additional security restrictions for PRs created from organization forks.
